_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% 12h score-movement base rate over 56 windows makes HOLD the statistically dominant call, and the analyst's 0-for-14 directional record confirms no brain has demonstrated an ability to call the breaker in this regime.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD respecting the coil; narrative leans bullish breakout. Judge sides with analyst based on higher trust weight and base-rate evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain above 80 with BTC momentum pushing above 65 and DXY breaking below 98 — confirms risk-on breakout from coil
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC funding drops below 0.005% with exchange netflow reversing below 50 and CVD turning negative — signals actual distribution matching elevated VIX/gold fear
